description: Decode the eth_call result YOUR node returned for a prepare_quote call: net output after the 0.28% fee, price impact, the Phoenix Check verdict (ok / caution / danger / blocked — fails closed) and, in preview mode, the on-chain floor the Quoter reports for the route (ironFloor, effectiveMinOut). With a recipient and a userMinOut, it also returns unsigned calldata verified against the request, whose minimum output is the higher of your userMinOut and the quoted net output less slippageBps, never under the on-chain floor (exact mode: exactly your userMinOut; a recipient without a usable userMinOut returns a txError instead). The calldata clears the swap math, not the token transfer: before sending, simulate it as an eth_call to the Router from the paying address. Pure computation: it cannot authenticate your node's answer.

result.description: the 0x hex result of the eth_call on your node

name: decode_quote
title: Decode a quote result
